meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可将 224x224 的 H&E 切片图转成空间基因表达:按你查询的基因符号,输出每个切片块的 log1p-CPM 值,并拼回原网格位置。
howto.when: 当你需要 H&E 切片的空间基因表达、按基因符号查询基因,或对整张切片做预测时触发。

say.text: 用这张 H&E 图预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达
say.note: 返回每个切片块这两个基因的表达值

say.text: 把这张切片按 224x224 切块后预测全转录组
say.note: 需要先切块,再逐批预测

say.text: 查一下基因 MS4A1 在这张切片里的空间表达
say.note: 会输出该基因在切片各位置的表达值

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transform a 224x224 H&E tile into spatial gene expression: for each gene symbol you query, it outputs per-tile log1p-CPM values and reassembles them on the original grid.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have an H&E tile or slide and need spatial gene expression, want to query genes by symbol, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression from this H&E image.
say_en.note: Returns per-tile values for those genes.

say_en.text: Tile this slide at 224x224 and predict the whole transcriptome.
say_en.note: Requires tiling first, then batched prediction.

say_en.text: Check MS4A1 spatial expression in this slide.
say_en.note: Outputs that gene's expression across tile positions.
